title: Where Lumen Creative's money went
headline: Jan–Sep 2026: €766k invoiced, €611k to run the agency — €156k profit before your dividends, €84k after. But only €20k is in the bank.
verdict_text: On paper Lumen makes money: a 20% margin, 11% after the €72k you took out. But cash covers about a week of costs, while €117k sits in invoices clients haven't paid yet.

actions.title: Collect the two overdue invoices this week
actions.text: Tidewater Energy's annual report (€18,000, due 23 Sep) and Opal Fitness's event photos (€2,400). Another €96k of September invoices falls due in October.

actions.title: Check the two missing Kestrel retainer invoices
actions.text: Kestrel Logistics pays €7,500 every month but nothing was invoiced for April and July — a missed invoice or a paused retainer?

actions.title: Bring team cost back to 55% of revenue
actions.text: Salaries and freelancers take 67% of revenue. Repricing Halden-type projects and the two retainers that run over their hours closes most of the gap.

insights.title: Halden Retail loses money
insights.text: It brought 11.6% of revenue, but both rebrand phases cost more in team time than they earned — about 2,400 hours for €89k.

insights.title: Two retainers take far more hours than they pay for
insights.text: Northpoint Dental gets about 90 hours a month against 60 agreed, Halcyon Hotels about 147 against 120. Across all five retainers the team works 15% over.

insights.title: The last quarter got better
insights.text: July–September margin was 29% vs 25% the quarter before: same revenue, 6% lower costs.

insights.title: January ran at a loss
insights.text: Project invoices landed in later months while salaries didn't — the cash dip started there.

locked.title: Will there be enough cash in December?
locked.text: With payroll on the 25th and VAT in December, the next 6 weeks decide a lot.
missing: expected payment dates for open invoices

locked.title: How busy the team really is
locked.text: 10,250 hours were logged, 85% billable — but against what capacity?
